q.instructions: Which option does `clause` ask for? Read it in the context of `intent`.

criteria.egress_profile: restrict which workloads, namespaces or destinations a workload may connect to (east-west or outbound traffic)
criteria.deny_privilege_escalation: stop containers running privileged, gaining more privileges than they start with, or running as root
criteria.restrict_registry: allow container images only from an approved registry, or block images from public registries
criteria.restrict_api_access: limit a workload's credentials, secrets or permissions on the Kubernetes API (needs RBAC; admission alone cannot)
criteria.deny_sa_token_for_agent_sidecars: stop an AI agent or assistant sidecar from using the Pod's Kubernetes identity (its service account token)
criteria.deny_agent_mutation_outside_namespace: stop an AI agent from changing workloads outside its own namespace
criteria.require_ticket_on_agent_changes: require a ticket or change reference on changes an AI agent makes
criteria.audit_replica_surge: flag sudden large increases in a workload's replica count
criteria.process: how or when to roll out or time-box the change (staging, expiries, not disrupting service), not what to allow
criteria.not_implementable: something admission control cannot see or enforce: reads, tool calls inside an application, runtime behaviour, people
